Scope-crossing CSS confirmed in dist/_astro/*.css: pillar :nth-child(2n) flip (scoped to Pillar hash, .pillar-visual shares it), check-icon :global(svg) rule with accent-text colour (21 check glyphs = 15 pillar + 6 pricing), terms-pill :global(.pill) white-space:normal override, section padding-block, counter-reset/increment step, prefers-reduced-motion, callout.ok/.err globals.

deviations: Astro scopes CSS per component. Selectors whose target lives in a different component's scope use :global() as the WI-2/WI-3 precedent (.btn :global(svg)): Pillar/PricingList check-icons (li :global(svg)), the pricing terms-pill relaxation (.terms :global(.pill)) which overrides the WI-3 Pill base rule WITHOUT editing the Pill primitive, PhoneMockup .iconbtn :global(svg), FaqItem summary :global(svg), and ContactForm callout.ok/.err (applied to #form-msg at runtime).

section{padding-block}, .cards/.band/.trio/.steps/.faq wrappers, counter-reset:step, and the prefers-reduced-motion * reset are page-composition/global concerns and live in a <style is:global> block in index.astro (global.css is WI-1 scope; page is explicitly in scope for this WI). Advisor-confirmed as the faithful 1:1 port.

SectionHead (WI-3 primitive) IS used for all four eyebrow+title(+lead) heads (why/features/how/faq); the features head passes its lead. The page-level global .sec-head duplicate was removed once SectionHead was wired — the rule now emits scoped to SectionHead's own hash. All five primitives (Button, Pill, Icon, FormField, SectionHead) are reused.

The copy-number button is Button size='sm' (min-height 44px, below the 48px touch-target guideline). This is a faithful port of the reference's .btn-sm and Button.astro is WI-3 scope — intentionally NOT diverged from the reference to 'fix' it.
Prices carry a real U+00A0 (verified in source bytes: 0xC2 0xA0 after '100') and survive into dist; set:html is used on those spans (harmless on static data; plain interpolation would also work).

The reference client <script> language-toggle + CS-from-DOM block was NOT ported (routing replaces it per the task). Only the toast/clipboard/validation stub was ported, via <script is:inline define:vars={{ messages }}> with the cs-resolved MSG dict. The demo setTimeout(...,600) stub and its exact 'wire this to your API' comment are preserved. No real fetch added.
The bespoke mockups (PhoneMockup, DispatchBoard, MiniMockup per-type, TinyPhone) each keep their entire markup + all their CSS in one .astro scope so no mockup-internal selector needs :global.
Decorative subtrees keep aria-hidden: Hero .stage, brand .trio, Pillar .pillar-visual, Origin .origin-map.
Czech copy currently lives inline in index.astro (section heads) and in src/data/*.ts (arrays) as required — WI-6 extracts to i18n. No t() layer invented here.
